rules.instruction: Do not use raw hex color literals (e.g. #ef4444, #06b6d4) or their equivalent values in other color formats (rgb, hsl, etc.) anywhere in component code. Always reference the design token system instead (e.g. var(--brand-primary)). This applies even when the color is expressed in a non-hex format that resolves to the same banned value.

check.message: Raw hex color values are banned. Use design tokens (e.g. var(--brand-primary)) instead, including equivalent values expressed in other formats like rgb().
